answer: Each identity must lock bonded collateral in escrow, so creating many keys does not create unbacked voting power. When k identities coordinate equivocation, evidence links their actions and penalties scale as O(k²), rather than being split into cheap individual fines. Detection also triggers an exponential multiplier in capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation preventing recovery of the full stake. Identities named glacier, ivory, and meadow receive no exemption.
